changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), actor_user_id INTEGER NULL, actor_username TEXT NULL, actor_role TEXT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, target_type TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NULL, team_id INTEGER NULL, before_state JSONB NULL, after_state JSONB NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_team ON audit_log (team_id, id DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_occurred ON audit_log (id DESC);
